title: CANcestry hardware traceability row (v0.1.0)
description: Schema for one row of the hardware traceability record hw/tests/traceability.csv (issue #33, H-01; HW-PLAN §10.8, HwAGENTS.md rule 4). The record is a one-row-per-(requirement, method) ledger: the extension columns capella_element_id, credibility_level and oracle_id ride on top of the requirement/method/status core. capella_element_id carries a non-empty Capella element identifier or the explicit H-01 placeholder CAP_PENDING/LA_PENDING until the Capella model exists (H-02, HW-PLAN G2). The status vocabulary is exactly the honest-ledger set from HwAGENTS.md rule 4; passing rows additionally require a registry-listed oracle_id, credibility >= required CL (a T1/T2 safety row may close provisionally below the required CL, pending T4 correlation, per the HwRS closure policy), and an evidence artifact hash. required_cl is the requirement's credibility level parsed from HwRS.md (ci/check_hw_traceability.py fails closed if the HwRS table format changes).

method.description: Verification method: analysis (T0), sim (T1 block simulation), t2 (T2 virtual bench), bench (T4 physical DVT/HIL).

capella_element_id.description: Capella element linking this row to the MBSE model; CAP_PENDING or LA_PENDING is the explicit H-01 placeholder until the model exists (H-02).

credibility_level.description: Credibility achieved by the evidence of this row (virtual-bench-plan §5). CL0 for rows without evidence yet.

oracle_id.description: Oracle from hw/tests/oracles/registry.csv; mandatory for every passing row (HW-PLAN §10.2), empty otherwise.

required_cl.description: Credibility required by the HwRS 'Req. CL' column for this requirement; cross-checked by ci/check_hw_traceability.py against HwRS.md.

status.description: Honest-ledger status (HwAGENTS.md rule 4). passing(sim,CLn,provisional) is the T1/T2 closure of a safety row whose required CL is higher, pending T4 bench correlation (HwRS closure policy).

evidence.description: Repository-relative path of the evidence JSON (hw/tests/evidence/<case_id>.json); mandatory for passing rows, empty otherwise.

evidence_sha256.description: sha256 of the evidence artifact, recomputed by ci/check_hw_traceability.py; mandatory for passing rows, empty otherwise.

validation_gap.description: Optional oracle validation gap metadata; the authoritative value is carried in the oracle registry.
